dropped.finding: The bound-snapshot precedence branch of _store_value returns `str(snapshot.values[section][key])` without passing the value through `validate`, unlike the CLI/env/raw branches which do `validate(...)`. No test exercises store_tickets_branch/store_tickets_remote when a bound snapshot is active, so a malformed value carried in a snapshot (e.g. a snapshot whose tracker.branch is "bad..branch") would be returned unvalidated and NOT raise ConfigError, silently violating the docstring's "a malformed one still raises ConfigError (fail closed)" contract. The malformed-value tests (test_invalid_store_branch_is_still_refused, test_invalid_store_remote_is_still_refused) run without an active snapshot and thus take the raw-layer branch only.
merged_from: The CLI-override precedence branch of _store_value (`value = (_CLI_OVERRIDES or {}).get(section, {}).get(key)`) is added behavior with no test. Only the env-override branch (test_store_remote_env_override_wins) and the raw-layer branch are covered, so a regression that broke CLI-override precedence for store_tickets_branch/store_tickets_remote would go undetected.
scenarios: A push/sync site runs under an active operation snapshot whose store branch/remote value is malformed; the fail-closed guard is bypassed.
